title: OHLCV Volume Persistence

protocol.question: Does continuous own-volume innovation improve one-hour activity and risk forecasts?
protocol.scope: activity/attention and risk prediction, not trading or causal flow identification

mechanics.multiple_testing: one Holm family across P1/P2 loss gains and MSE control contrasts

bootstrap.resampling_unit: complete UTC days within each pair/block evaluation split
bootstrap.aggregation: equal weight across informative pair/block units

concentration.method: positive event-level squared-error reduction normalized by evaluation events per unit

decision.decision: OHLCV VOLUME-PERSISTENCE HYPOTHESIS REJECTED IN PRIMARY SCOPE
decision.reason: P1 activity failed at least one pre-registered economic, statistical, control, or robustness gate.
decision.scope: activity/attention proxy and risk forecasting only; no flow, liquidity, causality, or trading claim

limitations: OHLCV volume is only an activity/attention proxy
no aggressor side, institutional flow, spread, depth, or causal liquidity is observed
activity prediction alone is not a tradable advantage
